practice_description: Free returns within 30 days of delivery
Packaging reuse and EPR fee reporting on returned goods
14-day withdrawal right; customer pays return postage on orders under 40 EUR
issue_note: Allowed if the customer is told before purchase.

practice_description: Returned items graded D or E are destroyed when no recycling stream is booked
regulatory_reference: KrWG 23 Obhutspflicht (duty of care for returned goods)
issue_note: Germany expects usable returned goods to be kept in use; destroying functional items is a breach of the duty of care and the transparency reporting.

practice_description: Returned electrical items are accepted at the DC only; stores do not take back old devices
issue_note: Distance sellers above the size threshold must offer free take-back of old devices; check whether our return points qualify.

practice_description: Return mailers and cartons reused without checking system registration
issue_note: Reused packaging must still be covered by our LUCID registration and data reports.

practice_description: Seller pays return shipping on all returns; 14-day withdrawal right
Unsold or returned non-food goods are destroyed after 90 days if not liquidated
regulatory_reference: AGEC law Art. 35 (ban on destroying unsold non-food goods)
issue_note: Destruction of unsold non-food goods is prohibited; goods must be donated or reused and the ban carries fines.

practice_description: Repacked returns go back on sale in original packaging without sorting labels
issue_note: Repacked items need the Triman logo and sorting information on the packaging.

practice_description: 14-day withdrawal right; customer pays return shipping
Refunds are processed within 21 days of goods received
issue_note: Refunds must be paid within 14 days of withdrawal; 21 days is a breach.

practice_description: Return mailers not registered with the national packaging fund
issue_note: Packaging placed on the Dutch market through returns repacking may need registration and fee reporting.
